title: The reflex arc: clinical relevance (R-10021)
description: The reflex arc is a neural process of the nervous system. Its role: the spinal circuit producing rapid involuntary responses without involving the brain. Closely associated with spinal cord, involuntary response, and protection. Clinicians watch The reflex arc because disorders of sensation perception trace back to it. Key fact: protects the body before conscious pain registers.
